mapper.select: SELECT sc.id,sc.subject_id AS subjectId,sc.user_id AS userId,sc.content, sc.like_count AS likeCount,sc.created_at AS createdAt, u.username AS username,u.nickname AS nickname,u.avatar_path AS avatarPath,u.signature AS signature FROM subject_comments sc JOIN users u ON sc.user_id=u.id WHERE sc.subject_id=#{subjectId} ORDER BY sc.created_at DESC

SELECT sc.id,sc.subject_id AS subjectId,sc.user_id AS userId,sc.content, sc.like_count AS likeCount,sc.created_at AS createdAt, u.username AS username,u.nickname AS nickname,u.avatar_path AS avatarPath,u.signature AS signature FROM subject_comments sc JOIN users u ON sc.user_id=u.id WHERE sc.subject_id=#{subjectId} ORDER BY sc.like_count DESC, sc.created_at DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM subject_comments WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE subject_comments SET like_count=like_count+1 WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE subject_comments SET like_count=like_count-1 WHERE id=#{id} AND like_count>0
